loading.title: Loading
loading.move: Move with arrow keys or WASD.

errors.loadSave: Could not load the saved game data
errors.loadAudio: Could not load the saved audio settings
errors.saveAudio: Could not save the audio settings

settings.title: Settings
settings.confirmLanguageChange: The game will reload to apply the language change. Continue?
settings.languageError: Could not save the language setting. Please try again.
settings.name: Name
settings.teamsDescription: If you were given an adventure team join code, type it in to join the team. When you are signed in, your achievements and XP are saved to your cloud save. They are not used for rankings or team scores.
settings.operationsDescription: If you were given an operation join code, type it in to join the operation. When you are signed in, your achievements and XP are saved to your cloud save. They are not used for rankings or team scores.

account.title: Account
account.intro: Signing in is optional. The game works without an account and without a network connection.
account.unconfigured: Sign-in is not available in this build.
account.pending: Continue in your browser to finish signing in.
account.offline: You are offline. You stay signed in and the game keeps working; the connection will be refreshed when you are back online.
account.persistenceUnavailable: Your sign-in cannot be saved on this computer (the system credential store is unavailable). You will need to sign in again after restarting.

errors.provider_denied: Sign-in was cancelled or not allowed.
errors.provider_error: The sign-in provider reported an error.
errors.login_timed_out: Sign-in took too long and timed out.
errors.network: Could not reach the sign-in service. Check your connection.
errors.keyring_unavailable: Your sign-in cannot be saved on this computer.
errors.logout_incomplete: You were signed out, but the saved sign-in could not be removed from this computer. It may come back after a restart.
errors.cancel_incomplete: The login attempt was cancelled, but its saved data could not be removed from this computer. It may come back after a restart.

sync.title: Cloud save
sync.offline: Could not reach the server. Your save is kept on this computer and will sync when you are back online.
sync.error: Syncing your save failed. It is kept on this computer and will be retried.
sync.unsupported: Update the app to sync your save.

liveEvents.title: Live Events
liveEvents.intro: Join a live event and compete on the public rankings. Scores come from achievements that the server has certified during the event.
liveEvents.none: There are no live events right now.
liveEvents.publicNotice: Only the display name you enter below, your rank, your score and your number of achievements are shown to everyone. Your save, email address and sign-in details are never shown. Achievements count from the moment you join. If you hide yourself, you are not listed, but your achievements still count toward your team.
liveEvents.signInRequired: Sign in on the Account tab to join. You can still read the rankings.
liveEvents.showInRanking: Show me in the individual ranking
liveEvents.statusHidden: You are not listed in the ranking. Your score is {{score}} points.

errors.account_changed: Another account is signed in now. Check the Account tab and try again.
errors.offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.server: The server is busy. Try again later.
errors.unauthorized: Your sign-in was not accepted. Sign in again.
errors.rejected: The server did not accept the request.
errors.event_closed: This event has ended and no longer accepts participants.
errors.not_eligible: You are not eligible for this event.
errors.invalid_display_name: Enter a display name of 1 to 32 characters without control characters.
errors.already_participant: You have already joined this event.
errors.not_participant: You have not joined this event.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong with live events.

choice.title: Which save do you want to use?
choice.intro: This computer and your account both have a save. Choose the one to keep; the other one is overwritten.

cloudSave.confirmUpload: The save on this computer was used with a different account. Upload it to the account you just signed in with? Choose Cancel to sign out without uploading.

notice.unsupported: The cloud save was written by a newer version of TerminalQuest. Update the app to sync it. Your local save is not affected.
notice.invalid: The cloud save could not be read, so it was not applied. Your local save is not affected.
notice.restoreFailed: The cloud save could not be applied to this computer. Sign in again to retry. Your game keeps running with its current data.
notice.tooLarge: Your save is too large to sync. Your local save is not affected.
notice.logoutFailed: Could not sign out of your account. It will be retried; you can also sign out in Settings > Account. Nothing was uploaded or changed.
